name: Major N. Ashley
role: Early elder sent south on a mission in 1832
dateNote: Section 75, dated 25 January 1832, sends him on a mission.
importance: Major Noble Ashley lived in Strongsville, Ohio, and joined the Church by June 1831. He was ordained an elder in October 1831. Section 75 sends him with Burr Riggs into “the south country.” He had left the Church by 1838.
connections: His named companion is Burr Riggs (75:17).

sources.title: Major Noble Ashley, Joseph Smith Papers biography

reviewNote: Birth 3 Mar. 1798 and church dates checked on JSP. JSP gives no death date or place, and I found none.
